findings.evidence: TimeSeriesDataset validates calendar membership with np.any(ranks == len(calendar)) or np.any(calendar[ranks] != observed). If a supplied calendar ends before an observed frame date, calendar[ranks] indexes one past the end and raises IndexError instead of the intended ValueError. The current training and saved-calendar inference paths use a full-panel calendar and are unaffected.
findings.fix: Check out-of-range ranks before indexing calendar, or compare only ranks known to be in bounds; add a small invalid-calendar assertion.
